Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Food Purchasing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Eggs can be stored at room temperature up to ___.
Rationale: At ambient tropical room temperature (25°C–30°C), table eggs deteriorate rapidly and maintain acceptable culinary and microbiological freshness for a maximum of 7 days before significant quality loss.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Storage, Egg Cookery

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which food processing method has been linked to cancer in laboratory animals?
Rationale: Traditional wood smoke curing deposits polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), such as benzo[a]pyrene, which are well-documented carcinogens and mutagens.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the list below is a soluble fiber?
Rationale: Pectin is a water-soluble dietary fiber found in plant cell walls and intercellular cement that forms viscous gels. Cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignin are insoluble fibers.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Chemistry, Dietary Fiber

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Gluten can be extracted from dough made from flour and water by ___.
Rationale: Washing and kneading dough under a gentle stream of cold water washes away water-soluble starches and albumins, leaving an elastic, cohesive mass of gluten (gliadin and glutenin).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Cereal & Flour, Gluten Extraction

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): All the following foods are good sources of niacin EXCEPT ___.
Rationale: Tuna, chicken breast, and mushrooms are rich sources of preformed niacin. A baked potato provides small amounts of niacin but is primarily a carbohydrate staple.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is the size of a placeplate (charger plate)?
Rationale: A standard placeplate (service charger plate) measures 11 to 12 inches in diameter. Dinner plates are 10 inches, salad/soup plates 8–9 inches, and bread-and-butter plates 6 inches.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Table Service, Dining Room Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A leadership style that requires that decisions are made by a group and is based on all members working together until an agreement is met:
Rationale: Consensus leadership involves collaborative problem-solving where all group members voice concerns and negotiate until a collective agreement supported by all is reached.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the following does NOT influence cooking time of meat?
Rationale: Standard culinary theory emphasizes that cooking method/temperature, thickness/cut size, and meat connective tissue density directly determine cooking duration.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Meat Cookery, Culinary Arts

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): According to the ND Law, all successful candidates in the licensure examination shall ___ prior to the practice of nutrition and dietetics.
Rationale: Under RA 10862, all successful board examinees are legally required to take the professional oath before the PRC Board of Nutrition and Dietetics prior to entering professional practice.
Option 2: Apply for Phil health and SSS

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The government agency with the primary responsibility of ensuring the food safety of consumers:
Rationale: Under the Food Safety Act of 2013 (RA 10611), the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of the Department of Health is responsible for the safety of processed and prepackaged food products.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is NOT correct in arranging food on a plate?
Rationale: Overloading a plate creates an unappealing, messy appearance; aesthetic plating requires balance, focal points, and adequate rim space.
Option 1: Rims must be free from drips.
Option 2: Sauce is poured over the meat or served separately in a sauceboat.
Option 3: Hot food should always served on a hot plate.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Meal Presentation, Culinary Arts

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The following activities require temperature control EXCEPT ___.
Rationale: Storage, thawing, cooking, holding, and receiving are physical critical control points requiring strict thermometer verification. Menu planning is an administrative paper task.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify the proper size of a soup plate.
Rationale: Standard chinaware dimensions: A soup plate (or deep rim soup bowl) is typically 9 inches in diameter. Placeplates are 12", dinner plates 10", and bread/butter plates 6".
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Table Setting, Foodservice Equipment

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): In order to make a perfect jelly, there should be a right combination of ___.
Rationale: The jelly triad requires precise equilibrium: 60–65% sugar, 0.5–1.0% high-methoxyl pectin, and a pH of 3.0–3.4 (acid) to form a stable pectin-sugar-acid gel network.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Preservation, Jelly Making

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is TRUE about pasteurized milk?
Answer (Back): Heat is applied to at least 61-65 C for at least 30 minutes
Rationale: Batch/vat pasteurization (LTLT - Low Temperature Long Time) heats milk to 62.8°C–65°C (145°F) for at least 30 minutes to destroy all pathogenic vegetative bacteria (such as Mycobacterium tuberculosis).
Option 1: Milk is treated under high pressure to reduce size of fat globules
Option 4: Heat is applied to at least 61-65 C for at least 30 minutes

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): To facilitate the receiving of goods, it is desirable to locate the receiving area near the ___.
Rationale: The receiving area must be placed adjacent to the exterior delivery door/dock so delivery trucks can offload shipments directly with minimal cross-traffic and temperature exposure.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Facility Planning, Layout & Design

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If the cost per portion of lamb shawarma with cheese is Php 20 with a 20% food cost, what would be the selling price?
Rationale: Selling Price = Raw Food Cost ÷ Food Cost Percentage = Php 20 ÷ 0.20 = Php 100.00.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the following practices in the food service business promotes care for the environment?
Rationale: Ecological solid waste management (segregation into biodegradable, recyclable, and residual waste) minimizes landfill contamination and promotes environmental sustainability in foodservice.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Waste Management, Foodservice Administration

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which enzyme CANNOT tenderize meat?
Rationale: Papain (papaya), bromelain (pineapple), and ficin (figs) are proteolytic enzymes that tenderize meat. Glucose oxidase is an enzyme used in desugaring eggs to prevent Maillard browning during drying.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is responsible for the tough and fibrous inner core in carrots?
Rationale: Lignin is a complex non-carbohydrate polymer deposited in woody plant vascular bundles (xylem core of carrots) that does not soften significantly during cooking.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Chemistry, Plant Anatomy

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is an example of unethical practice?
Answer (Back): Favoring a supplier which provides an expensive gift to you.
Rationale: Accepting personal gifts or kickbacks in exchange for awarding procurement contracts is a severe breach of professional purchasing ethics and represents a direct conflict of interest.
Option 1: Seeking approval from a director before purchasing expensive office equipment.
Option 2: Favoring a supplier which provides an expensive gift to you.
Option 3: Asking for a solicitation for prizes in the office Christmas party
Option 4: Informing your HR on your other sources of income aside from your regular job.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Process of assigning job activities and authority to a specific employee within the organization:
Rationale: Delegation is the process of assigning responsibility and necessary authority to subordinates to accomplish designated tasks.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Thames University offers dishes in their canteen which are repeatedly offered every 30 days. From time to time, the canteen concessionaire also offers menus which are in season. Which type of menu is this?
Rationale: A cycle menu is a carefully planned sequence of menus repeated over a specified time interval (e.g., a 30-day or 4-week cycle).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Planning, Foodservice Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Annatto extract is added in food to enhance natural colors. This additive acts as ___.
Rationale: Annatto (atsuete) is a natural carotenoid-based food coloring additive containing bixin and norbixin that imparts a vibrant yellow-orange color to foods.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Dante is a purchasing officer at First Fruits company. The bidding was opened for new equipment. Supplier A provided the lowest bid. Supplier B provided a slightly higher bid but offered Dante a free trip to Hong Kong. Which supplier would Dante choose?
Answer (Back): Supplier A as it offers the lowest bid and Supplier B's practice is against the code of integrity.
Rationale: Professional purchasing integrity requires objective evaluation based on lowest responsive bid and specifications; accepting personal travel incentives violates business ethics and company procurement rules.
Option 1: Supplier B as it offers a free trip promo.
Option 2: Supplier A as it offers the lowest bid and Supplier B's practice is against the code of integrity.
Option 3: Supplier B as it fosters a good relationship with the client
Option 4: Get one item from Supplier A and the rest from Supplier B.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is the age of meat if the color is pink?
Rationale: Young animal muscle (such as milk-fed veal from young calves under 3 months) contains minimal myoglobin concentration, producing a pale delicate pink meat color.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Meat Science, Food Quality

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Select which is NOT correct about carbon footprint.
Answer (Back): indicates the amount of organic ingredients in the menu
Rationale: A carbon footprint quantifies total greenhouse gas emissions (in CO2 equivalents) generated across the life cycle of food. It does not measure or indicate organic ingredient percentages.
Option 1: estimates the climate change impact in producing food
Option 2: measures the impact on the environment
Option 3: measures the amount of greenhouse gases emitted
Option 4: indicates the amount of organic ingredients in the menu

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A management function that involves inspecting the work that is done, ensuring the standards are met and monitoring that the work is done as planned:
Rationale: Controlling is the managerial process of setting performance standards, measuring ongoing performance against those standards, and taking corrective actions when deviations occur.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The similarity of dressed and drawn chicken is that ___.
Rationale: Dressed poultry is slaughtered, bled, and defeathered (head, feet, and viscera intact). Drawn poultry is dressed poultry with the visceral organs and entrails removed. Both are defeathered.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What ingredient can be an extender for Chicken Adobo to have more yield?
Rationale: Starchy vegetables like cubed potatoes absorb adobo braising juices and bulk up dish volume cost-effectively without altering the quintessential savory-vinegar adobo profile.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Preparation, Philippine Cookery

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which enzyme causes fruit to ripen?
Rationale: Pectinase enzymes (such as polygalacturonase and pectin methylesterase) break down insoluble protopectin into soluble pectin, softening plant cell walls during ripening.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Chemistry, Post-Harvest Physiology

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is an example of an incomplete protein?
Rationale: Gelatin is derived from collagen and completely lacks tryptophan, an essential amino acid, making it an incomplete protein with low biological value.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Meat of a mature sheep is ___.
Rationale: Mutton is the meat of adult sheep (older than 1 year). Lamb is from sheep under 1 year, and veal is from young calves.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Meat Cookery, Food Standards

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): In a conventional food service flow diagram, which is situated in the central area?
Rationale: The main cooking/hot production bank is typically situated at the operational center of the kitchen layout to provide shortest transit paths to receiving/prep on one side and service/plating on the other.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Facility Planning, Layout & Design

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Pilaf: Middle East; ___: Spain
Rationale: Paella is the iconic saffron-scented national rice dish of Spain. Nasi goreng is Indonesian, and Basmati is an Indian long-grain rice variety.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, International Cuisines, Culinary Geography

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is the ideal number of members when you have consumer panel test?
Rationale: Consumer acceptance panels require large cohorts of untrained consumers (typically 50 to 100+ panelists) to achieve statistical significance for product market acceptance.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Sensory Evaluation, Product Development

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A leadership style based on the "majority rules", in which decisions are made by the group rather than a manager alone:
Rationale: Democratic (participative) leadership encourages employees to participate in decision-making and relies on group discussion, voting, and majority decisions.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The following agencies are responsible in ensuring the safety of our food products EXCEPT FOR:
Rationale: The DA (primary agricultural food safety), DOH, and FDA (processed foods) are official regulatory agencies under RA 10611. The Commission on Population (POPCOM) handles population and family planning.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Safety Act, Government Agencies

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): India: Roti; France: ___.
Rationale: Roti is the traditional daily staple flatbread of India; the Baguette is the traditional daily staple bread of France.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The minimum temperature for sterilization for a certain length of time is ___.
Rationale: Sterilization in food thermal processing requires achieving temperatures at least at or above 100°C (boiling point) for acid foods, or 121°C in retorts for low-acid foods.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Rona, a product formulator, would like to assess consumers' preference of five ice cream variants from "most like" to "least like". Which is the appropriate sensory evaluation method to use?
Rationale: A ranking test asks panelists to arrange 3 or more coded samples in ordinal sequence according to degree of liking, sweetness, or preference.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Sensory Evaluation, Quality Assessment

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Green tea, grapes and wine are high in phytonutrients called ___.
Rationale: Polyphenols (including epigallocatechin gallate in green tea, and resveratrol and anthocyanins in grapes and red wine) are potent antioxidant phytochemicals.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): How many teaspoons are there in 1 tablespoon?
Rationale: Standard culinary and pharmaceutical liquid measure: 1 tablespoon = 3 teaspoons = 15 mL = 1/2 fluid ounce.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Weights & Measures, Kitchen Math

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What do you call a white flour resulting from removal of at least 25% of the bran and shorts during milling?
Rationale: Refined white flour is produced after milling away the protective bran and germ fractions (at least 25% of the grain), leaving pure starchy endosperm.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Cereal & Starch, Food Technology

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Krizzia is counselling Ralstein, an obese patient depressed about body image wanting major lifestyle changes. Krizzia's initial objective in the interviewing process should be to:
Answer (Back): Establish rapport with Ralstein by getting to know her better before discussing anything
Rationale: Establishing initial trust, unconditional positive regard, and emotional rapport is the essential first phase of therapeutic nutrition counselling before gathering technical diet recalls.
Option 1: Discuss the role of a nutritionist-dietitian and set expectation of the professional fee
Option 2: Determine the 24-hr food recall and anthropometric measurements
Option 3: Establish rapport with Ralstein by getting to know her better before discussing anything
Option 4: Determine food preferences and current medications Ralstein is taking in.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Dante is a medical representative from a nutraceutical company who visited Krizzia in the office. Identify an UNACCEPTABLE practice:
Answer (Back): Krizzia is requesting Dante for a sponsorship to her mom's party
Rationale: Soliciting personal sponsorships, gifts, or financial benefits for family events from commercial pharmaceutical/nutraceutical representatives is a direct violation of professional healthcare ethics.
Option 1: Dante explains the benefits of the newly launched product to Krizzia
Option 2: Dante inviting Krizzia to attend a launch of their new product in a five-star hotel
Option 3: Krizzia is receiving samples of nutraceuticals for distribution to her patients
Option 4: Krizzia is requesting Dante for a sponsorship to her mom's party

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify an example of a conflict of interest in dietary practice:
Answer (Back): Krizzia sells her own products to the patients aside from the company's products
Rationale: Selling personal proprietary products directly to clinic patients creates financial self-dealing that compromises clinical objectivity and breaches fiduciary duty to the patient.
Option 1: Krizzia listens to Dante's product presentation when there is no patient
Option 2: Krizzia sells her own products to the patients aside from the company's products
Option 3: Ralstein mentions her travel business to Krizzia and offers her some promos
Option 4: Krizzia invests in the company's cooperative for regular employees

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Melanie launched a new liquor chocolate cake in her bakeshop and would like to assess acceptability of the new product among consumers. Which activity should Melanie perform?
Rationale: Sensory evaluation through consumer acceptance and hedonic testing is the scientific discipline used to evoke, measure, analyze, and interpret human sensory responses to new food products.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Sensory Evaluation, Bakery Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is the sensory characteristic corresponding to the size and color of the cake?
Rationale: Visual appearance encompasses color, size, shape, surface sheen, crumb structure, and physical geometry evaluated by sight.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Sensory Evaluation, Food Quality

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which sensory characteristic is measured through sniffing the cake?
Rationale: Aroma refers specifically to volatile odorant molecules detected through the olfactory epithelium via direct sniffing (orthonasal olfaction).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A supplier delivered fresh meats and seafood to Lea one morning. Which of the following items shall she reject?
Rationale: Fresh fish must have clear, bulging eyes and bright red gills; sunken, dull, cloudy eyes are a clear physical indicator of post-mortem spoilage and bacterial breakdown.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Lea prefers to purchase more items which have longer shelf life. Which of the items below have the longest shelf life?
Rationale: Dry polished white rice has a water activity below 0.65 and can be stored safely in dry conditions for 1 to 2+ years without spoiling, far exceeding perishable fresh produce and milk.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Storage, Shelf Life

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the food items is prone to having molds?
Rationale: Bread has high moisture (Aw ~0.95), neutral pH, and exposure to airborne mold spores during cooling and slicing, making it highly susceptible to Rhizopus stolonifer (black bread mold).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Meals served inside the aircraft came from the central kitchen. This type of foodservice system is ___.
Rationale: In a commissary foodservice system, centralized food procurement and large-scale bulk production occur in a central kitchen, and prepared meals are distributed to satellite service sites (like airline flights).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Anthocyanins: ___; Anthonxanthins: ___.
Rationale: Anthocyanins produce red, purple, and blue pigments (e.g., berries, red cabbage), while anthoxanthins produce white, ivory, and light yellow pigments (e.g., cauliflower, potato).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Chemistry, Plant Pigments

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The rice which is served in this Middle Eastern flight airline is ___.
Rationale: Pilaf (such as Basmati rice pilaf cooked with whole spices and broth) is the signature rice preparation served across Middle Eastern aviation and catering routes.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Airline Catering, Middle Eastern Cuisine

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The dessert which is served in this Middle Eastern flight airline is ___.
Rationale: Baklava is the classic rich Middle Eastern pastry made of layers of filo dough filled with chopped nuts and sweetened with honey or spiced syrup.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify which refers to food items that are individually priced:
Rationale: An A la Carte menu prices each food item individually, allowing diners to select and pay for individual dishes separately according to preference.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Planning, Foodservice Terminology

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which one refers to food items grouped together at a single price?
Rationale: Table d'Hote (or prix fixe) offers a complete multi-course meal (appetizer, entree, dessert) grouped together at a single fixed set price.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): This also means "menu of the day":
Rationale: Du Jour is French for 'of the day' (e.g., Soup du Jour), designating seasonal dishes or daily specials featured only on that particular day.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Terminology, Culinary French

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Heidi is a school nutrition consultant in a high school canteen with around 3,000 students. Heidi developed a standard recipe of Chicken Pastel which yields 20 portions. What will be the recipe conversion factor to serve lunch for the 3,000 students?
Rationale: Recipe Conversion Factor (RCF) = Desired Yield ÷ Current Recipe Yield = 3,000 servings ÷ 20 servings = 150.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Recipe Conversion

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If the total food cost for the standard recipe (yielding 20 portions) is Php 287.11, what is the total food cost per serving?
Rationale: Food Cost per Serving = Total Recipe Food Cost ÷ Number of Portions = Php 287.11 ÷ 20 = Php 14.3555 ≈ Php 14.36.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Portion Costing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What will be the recommended selling price for the Chicken Pastel portion (cost Php 14.36) using the standard markup factor of 2.0 (50% food cost)?
Rationale: Selling Price = Food Cost per Portion × Markup Factor = Php 14.36 × 2.0 = Php 28.72 (or Php 14.36 ÷ 0.50 = Php 28.72).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Pricing Strategies

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Noel will buy a jam. He would choose a fruit preserve which is ___.
Answer (Back): Made from ground or mashed cooked fruit
Rationale: Jam is prepared from crushed, mashed, or ground whole fruit cooked with sugar until thickened. (Jelly is from strained juice; Marmalade contains suspended citrus peel slices).
Option 2: Made from the juice of cooked fruit with added sugar
Option 3: Made from ground or mashed cooked fruit
Option 4: From juice with thin slices of fruit, especially citrus fruits
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Preservation, Fruit Preserves

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Noel also purchased fresh fruits like apple, banana, grapes and mulberries. Which of these is best kept at room temperature to avoid chilling injury?
Rationale: Bananas are tropical climacteric fruits that suffer chilling injury (skin blackening due to polyphenol oxidase and loss of aroma) when stored below 13°C (55°F); they must be held at room temperature.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Cinnamon is from ___.
Rationale: Cinnamon is harvested from the inner dried bark of Cinnamomum trees (such as Cinnamomum zeylanicum or verum).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Spices & Herbs, Food Science

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): When preparing the fruit spread, which of the ingredients are critical to be in correct balance?
Rationale: The jelly/jam gel network is governed by the equilibrium between pectin polymer chains, sugar (which dehydrates pectin molecules), and acid (which neutralizes negative charges to allow junction zone bonding).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Preservation, Gel Formation

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If the standard recipe requires 1 kg of chicken which yields 10 servings, how many kilos of chicken will be purchased for 70 regular cafeteria customers?
Rationale: Quantity required = (70 servings ÷ 10 servings per kg) × 1 kg = 7 kg.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Food Purchasing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If the total food cost per serving is Php 16.76, what will be the selling price using the 50% food cost factor?
Rationale: Selling Price = Food Cost per Portion ÷ Food Cost Percentage = Php 16.76 ÷ 0.50 = Php 33.52.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is the total food cost of the entire standardized recipe for 20 portions (food cost per serving Php 16.76)?
Rationale: Total Recipe Cost = 20 portions × Php 16.76 per portion = Php 335.20.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Recipe Costing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The Castillo family organized a formal thanksgiving dinner for Commissioner Craig in Rockwell. What is the MOST appropriate table service for this formal state occasion?
Rationale: Russian service (Service a la Russe) is the most formal style of dining service: all food is prepared and garnished in the kitchen, portioned onto platters, and served directly to seated guests by waitstaff using serving spoons and forks.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Table Service, Banquet Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Who should the waiter serve first during the formal dinner?
Rationale: In traditional dining etiquette and diplomatic protocol, the guest of honor (Commissioner Craig) is always served first, followed by female guests, and finally the hosts.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Table Service, Dining Etiquette

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the following acts of a waiter is INAPPROPRIATE based on the principles of table setting and dining service?
Answer (Back): Wine glasses were almost filled near the brim.
Rationale: Wine glasses should never be filled to the brim; red wine glasses are poured only 1/3 to 1/2 full to allow space for swirling, aeration, and volatile aroma release.
Option 1: All beverages were removed from the right of the guests.
Option 2: Wine glasses were almost filled near the brim.
Option 3: All food were placed and removed from the left of the guests
Option 4: Dinner knife is placed to the right of the plate.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Beverage Service, Dining Etiquette

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Aling Baby runs a university cafeteria. She never runs out of dishes to offer in her food stall for the entire month as she has ___.
Rationale: A monthly cycle menu rotates a carefully planned variety of dishes over 30 days, preventing customer monotony and simplifying bulk purchasing and preparation schedules.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Planning, Cafeteria Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Mongo is always being offered every Friday in the cafeteria. This regular daily feature is called ___.
Rationale: A special dish featured consistently on a specific recurring day of the week functions as a daily special / specialty of the day (Du Jour).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Planning, Menu Terminology

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A standard school cafeteria is an example of ___ operation.
Rationale: School cafeterias typically operate on a conventional foodservice model where raw ingredients are purchased, prepared, cooked, and served to students on the same premises.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Foodservice Systems, Operational Models

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The "A" in FATTOM, an acronym used to describe the conditions in microbial growth, means ___.
Rationale: FATTOM: Food, Acidity (pH 4.6–7.5), Time, Temperature (4°C–60°C), Oxygen, and Moisture (Aw ≥ 0.85).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The three-compartment sink should be placed in ___ area.
Rationale: The three-compartment sink (Wash with detergent at 110°F, Rinse in clean water, Sanitize in 171°F water or chemical sanitizer) is the core fixture of manual warewashing in the dishwashing/scullery area.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The exhaust hood with filter should be placed in ___ area.
Rationale: Ventilation and exhaust hoods with grease filters must be positioned directly above thermal cooking equipment (ranges, fryers, griddles) to capture grease vapors, smoke, steam, and heat.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The architect considered the standard clearance width of the main traffic aisle which is ___.
Rationale: In commercial kitchen and cafeteria facility layout, the main traffic aisle through which mobile carts and two-way personnel traffic move requires a minimum clearance of 5 feet (60 inches). Single-cook work aisles require 3 feet.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Facility Planning, Kitchen Dimensions

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Bona, the owner, would like to test which of her two Strawberry smoothies' formulation is better. What test can she conduct?
Rationale: Paired comparison sensory testing presents panelists with two coded samples simultaneously to evaluate which sample has greater attribute intensity (e.g., sweetness) or overall preference.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Sensory Evaluation, Product Testing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The cafe is operating on a 35% food cost. If the raw food cost of an Apple Carrot smoothie is Php 50, what will be the selling price?
Rationale: Selling Price = Raw Food Cost ÷ Food Cost Percentage = Php 50 ÷ 0.35 = Php 142.86, rounded to the nearest standard menu price of Php 145.00.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The architect considered the standard clearance width for a single worker station aisle:
Rationale: For a single kitchen workstation aisle where only one cook operates, the minimum recommended safe passage width is 3 feet (36 inches).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Carlos prepares broccoli and spinach juice. Adding lemon juice in it will change the color to ___.
Rationale: Chlorophyll pigments in green vegetables are acid-labile; the hydrogen ions from lemon juice displace the central magnesium atom in chlorophyll, converting it into dull olive-brown pheophytin.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Adding lemon juice in carrot juice will have ___.
Rationale: Carotenoid pigments are fat-soluble and exceptionally stable across varying pH levels, but mild acidification in fresh juices clarifies the suspension and yields a bright yellow-orange tone.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Adding lemon juice in beetroot juice will have ___.
Rationale: Betalain pigments in beetroot (specifically red betacyanins) shift to a vibrant, intense bright red/purplish-red hue in acidic environments (pH 4–5).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Skygazer offers Kalderetang Kambing which is "menu for the day" or also called ___.
Rationale: 'Menu for the day' is designated as Du Jour (or Menu du Jour) in French culinary dining service nomenclature.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Menu Terminology, Culinary French

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): These are non-digestible food substances that stimulate the growth of good bacteria in the gut.
Rationale: Prebiotics are non-digestible dietary fibers (e.g., fructooligosaccharides, inulin) that nourish and stimulate the proliferation of beneficial probiotic bacteria.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The total raw food cost of Kalderetang Kambing yielding 20 portions is Php 1,000. To keep the raw food cost at 40%, the selling price per portion should be ___.
Rationale: Cost per portion = Php 1,000 ÷ 20 = Php 50. Selling price = Php 50 ÷ 0.40 = Php 125.00.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The most economical and effective way to promote a newly opened neighborhood restaurant is through ___.
Rationale: Social media digital marketing provides the lowest cost per impression, viral visual reach, geo-targeted audience promotion, and interactive consumer engagement.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Wilma's catering is responsible for providing meals for a wedding where the couple are strict vegetarians. Which of the following dishes was NOT accepted by the couple?
Rationale: Traditional oyster sauce is prepared by condensing oyster broth extracted from bivalve mollusks (animal origin), making it strictly forbidden for vegetarians.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A buko pandan recipe requires 12 cups of quick-cooking tapioca. Tapioca is purchased in cases of 24 boxes (each box weighs 1kg). Each case costs Php 1,500. If each cup weighs 200g, what is the recipe cost for tapioca?
Rationale: Weight needed = 12 cups × 200g = 2,400g = 2.4 kg. 1 case contains 24 boxes × 1 kg = 24 kg, costing Php 1,500. Cost per kg = Php 1,500 ÷ 24 kg = Php 62.50/kg. Recipe cost = 2.4 kg × Php 62.50 = Php 150.00.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Purchasing Math

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What kind of soup can be served during the vegetarian wedding dinner?
Rationale: Cream of mushroom prepared with mushrooms, vegetable broth, and dairy cream is suitable for lacto-vegetarians. Fish balls, crab, and traditional Tom Yum (shrimp broth/fish sauce) contain seafood.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is NOT mandatory to be declared on prepackaged food container labels under Philippine FDA labeling standards?
Rationale: Mandatory Philippine FDA food labeling rules require product name, ingredient list, net contents, manufacturer details, and nutrition facts. Commercial marketing logos (like 'Wise Eat') are purely optional branding.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Laws, Labeling Requirements

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If a food product contains 15g of carbohydrates, 5g of fats and 10g of protein, how much is the total energy value?
Rationale: Atwater energy factors: (15g CHO × 4 kcal) + (10g PRO × 4 kcal) + (5g FAT × 9 kcal) = 60 + 40 + 45 = 145 kcal.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Nutrition Math, Atwater Factors

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The FDA evaluator would exempt this product from nutrition labelling:
Answer (Back): Ketchup with less than 10 cm surface area
Rationale: Under Codex and FDA labeling regulations, single-serve condiment packets and small packages with a total printable surface area under 10 cm² are exempt from mandatory nutrition facts panels due to space limitations.
Option 2: Milk for infants less than 2 years of age
Option 4: Ketchup with less than 10 cm surface area
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Labeling, FDA Regulations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A standard university cafeteria is classified as ___ foodservice system.
Rationale: University cafeterias traditionally operate conventional systems with complete kitchen equipment where raw food is cooked on-site and held hot for immediate cafeteria counter service.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Foodservice Systems, Cafeteria Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Fast foods such as McDonald's, Jollibee and KFC utilize standardized pre-portioned bulk commissary items and rapid finishing on-site, falling under ___.
Rationale: Modern quick-service chains rely heavily on assembly-serve (or commissary-assembly) principles where pre-breaded patties, portioned sauces, and par-fried items are delivered frozen and quickly assembled/finished with minimal culinary skill.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Foodservice Systems, Quick Service

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Overboiling of egg will result to ___.
Rationale: Excessive heat causes overcoagulation of egg white and yolk proteins, causing syneresis and the formation of a dark grayish-green ferrous sulfide ring at the yolk-white interface.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Egg Cookery, Protein Reactions

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): It is an organism able to grow at high temperature.
Rationale: Thermophiles thrive in hot temperatures, typically between 45°C and 80°C (113°F–176°F). Psychrotrophs grow at cold temperatures (0°C–7°C).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Sandwiches and chilled meals displayed in the glass chillers of 7-Eleven, AlfaMart, and Ministop are all examples of ___ foodservice items.
Rationale: Ready-prepared foodservice items are cooked in advance, rapidly chilled (cook-chill) or frozen, and stored under cold refrigeration for extended shelf-life before purchase and microwave reheating by consumers.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): This occurs during the first five minutes of baking due to the acceleration of fermentation due to the heat, causing the rise of the dough.
Rationale: Oven spring is the sudden rapid expansion of dough during early baking, driven by thermal expansion of trapped carbon dioxide and accelerated yeast activity before thermal death.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify the dishes which are popular in Mindanao Region.
Rationale: Bas-uy (liver soup), Linat-an (boiled pork bone soup), and Paklay (spiced pork/beef innards) are widely known regional specialties of Mindanao and Central/Southern Visayas.
Option 1: Sinigang na Kanduli, Sisig and Bringhe
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Regional Cuisines, Philippine Culture

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Food is hot filled into the container then sealed under aseptic conditions and processed immediately is called ___.
Rationale: In the hot pack method, heated food is packed hot into jars or cans, driving out air and ensuring quicker heat penetration during final canning/retort processing.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The browning of baked products is due to ___.
Rationale: Maillard browning occurs when amino acids and reducing sugars interact under dry heat, creating golden-brown pigments (melanoidins) and pleasant roasted flavors.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is a right of employees concerning vacation leaves, working hours and holidays?
Rationale: Under the Labor Code of the Philippines, employees have statutory entitlements to proper payment for work performed, statutory holiday premiums, and approved service incentive leaves.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Foodservice Management, Labor Code

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which government agency is responsible in licensing, monitoring, and regulating the food products being sold in the market?
Rationale: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) of the Philippines regulates and licenses processed foods, drugs, and cosmetics under Republic Act No. 9711.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Laws, Regulatory Agencies

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is a type of food spoilage that includes enzymatic reactions in living things as influenced by temperature, moisture, pH and the nutrients present?
Rationale: Biochemical spoilage (autolysis) involves the action of natural enzymes already present within animal or plant tissues after harvest or slaughter.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The labor cost for a certain dish is Php20 per hour. If it takes 45 minutes to make the dish, what is the labor cost for this particular dish?
Rationale: Labor cost = Hourly rate × (45 / 60 hours) = Php 20 × 0.75 = Php 15.00.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Costing & Calculation, Labor Costing

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The enzyme which is important for cheese production is ___.
Rationale: Renin (chymosin / rennet) hydrolyzes the Phe105-Met106 peptide bond in kappa-casein, causing milk proteins to coagulate into curd.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What condition favors the growth of Clostridium botulinum?
Answer (Back): Absence of air and low acidic environment
Rationale: Clostridium botulinum is an obligate anaerobe that thrives in low-acid conditions (pH > 4.6) in the absence of oxygen, producing a potent neurotoxin.
Option 2: Absence of air and low acidic environment
Option 4: Presence of air and high acidic environment

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The softest cheese among the following is ___.
Rationale: Brie is a soft-ripened cheese containing over 50% moisture, making it much softer than semi-hard (Gouda, Edam) and hard (Cheddar) cheeses.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Choose a form of disaccharide usually used in the production of beer.
Rationale: Maltose (malt sugar, consisting of two alpha-D-glucose molecules) is generated during the malting and mashing of barley grains and is fermented by yeast into ethanol in brewing.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Essential amino acids are ___.
Rationale: The 9 essential amino acids that must be supplied by diet are Histidine, Isoleucine, Leucine, Lysine, Methionine, Phenylalanine, Threonine, Tryptophan, and Valine (mnemonic: PVT TIM HLL).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Nutrition Science, Amino Acids

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is NOT true about Churros?
Rationale: Churros are piped choux-like dough that is deep-fried (not baked) in hot oil and traditionally served dusted with sugar/cinnamon alongside thick hot dipping chocolate.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Culinary Arts, Pastry & Baking

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): During a review of customer feedback survey, Michelle, RND, noted a pattern of dissatisfaction with the consistency of the quality of the beef caldereta. The most likely cause for the problem would be ___.
Answer (Back): the quality of the beef used not consistent with the specifications.
Rationale: Inconsistent meat cuts, connective tissue tenderness, and fat marbling from unstandardized purchasing specifications cause variable meat texture and toughness across batches.
Option 1: diners are unaware of the true taste of beef caldereta.
Option 2: the quality of the beef used not consistent with the specifications.
Option 3: the waiters are not using the appropriate size dishes when plating the dish
Option 4: the cooks are not using the standardized recipe.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What dish can be made to utilize leftover steamed kangkong from the last family dinner?
Rationale: Utan (Visayan vegetable soup) readily incorporates leftover steamed leafy greens like kangkong. Baye-baye is a sweet rice delicacy; dinakdakan and sisig are grilled pork offal dishes.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Preparation, Leftovers Management

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The "F" in FATTOM, an acronym used to describe the conditions in microbial growth, means ___.
Rationale: The 'F' in FATTOM stands for Food (specifically nutrients like proteins and carbohydrates that bacteria feed on).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which kind of damage results from dehydration of a frozen breaded chicken patty due to extreme cold?
Rationale: Freezer burn is the dehydration and oxidation that occurs when frozen food is improperly wrapped, causing moisture sublimation and dry, bleached, spongy surfaces.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): How do you call the bacteria which can be found in powdered infant formula which can cause meningitis?
Rationale: Enterobacter sakazakii (now Cronobacter sakazakii) is a pathogen known to contaminate powdered infant formula, causing severe neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis, sepsis, and meningitis.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What will happen to sugar if it is heated above 160 degrees C?
Rationale: Caramelization is the thermal decomposition of sucrose and other carbohydrates when dry heated to around 160°C–180°C, producing golden-brown color and buttery nutty flavors.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Chemistry, Sugar Cookery

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the following milk products has the longest shelf life?
Rationale: Ultra-High Temperature (UHT) milk is commercially sterilized at 135–150°C and aseptically packaged, giving it a stable shelf life of 6 to 9 months at room temperature without refrigeration.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which department is NOT involved in the receiving process in hospital's foodservice?
Rationale: Receiving involves the Dietary department (inspecting specifications), Purchasing (matching purchase orders), and Accounting (invoice/invoice tracking). Human Resources manages personnel, not daily delivery logistics.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The muscle pigment is called ___.
Rationale: Myoglobin is the primary iron- and oxygen-binding hemoprotein found in skeletal muscle tissues responsible for meat color. Hemoglobin is in red blood cells.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Meat Science, Food Chemistry

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Select the BEST way to manage leftovers from the morning buffet at the hotel.
Answer (Back): Sell leftovers at the employees' cafeteria at low cost
Rationale: Selling wholesome surplus buffet foods immediately in the employee cafeteria at subsidized rates recovers costs safely while avoiding customer food-safety liabilities of re-serving on buffets.
Option 1: Serve the same food to the diners for lunch and dinner
Option 2: Sell leftovers at the employees' cafeteria at low cost
Option 3: Freeze the leftover and serve the following day
Option 4: Let the employees take out all the leftovers everyday
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Waste Management, Foodservice Operations

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is true about passing the licensure examination for ND based on the ND law in 2016?
Answer (Back): Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 50% in any subjects
Rationale: Under Republic Act No. 10862 (Nutrition and Dietetics Law of 2016), a candidate must obtain a General Weighted Average of at least 75%, with no grade below 50% in any given examination subject.
Option 1: Must have a general average of 70% with no rating below 70% in any subjects
Option 2: Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 70% in any subjects
Option 3: Must obtain at least 80% general average in all of the subjects
Option 4: Must have a general average of 75% with no rating below 50% in any subjects
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, RA 10862, PRC Board Exam Rules

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify the thread-like noodles which made from cassava and wheat flour.
Rationale: Miswa is an extremely thin, thread-like salted Chinese-style noodle made from wheat flour and cassava/corn starch. (Sotanghon is made from mung bean starch; Canton is egg noodle).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Philippine Foods, Noodle Classification

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Lutong Bahay canteen is operating in Makati. All the food preparation is done in the area. It also accommodates short orders like pancit and tapsilog. This foodservice system is ___.
Rationale: In a conventional foodservice system, ingredients are assembled and all food preparation and cooking are performed on-site immediately prior to service or short-order preparation.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Foodservice Systems, Operational Models

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which of the following foods are responsible for most allergic reactions?
Rationale: The 'Big 8' major food allergens responsible for over 90% of allergic reactions include milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, wheat, soy, fish, and crustacean shellfish.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What is the most cost-efficient way of scouting for an applicant for a mid-level to high-level position?
Rationale: LinkedIn provides targeted professional searches, resume viewing, and credential verification at lower cost and higher precision than general newspapers or broad job fairs.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Laing and Binagol are both dishes made from gabi leaves and coconut milk. Laing is a dish from Bicol while Binagol is from ___.
Rationale: Binagol is a sweet regional delicacy of Eastern Visayas (Leyte and Samar) made from mashed taro (talyan/gabi), coconut milk, condensed milk, and sugar packed into a coconut shell (bagol).
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Regional Cuisines, Philippine Culture

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is NOT a characteristic of a fresh egg?
Rationale: Eggshells naturally have 7,000 to 17,000 tiny porous openings that allow respiratory gas and moisture exchange; an 'unporous shell' does not exist in nature.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Egg Cookery, Food Quality

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): This food additive is added in salad dressings to allow smooth mixture of ingredients without separation. Examples of this additive are soy lecithin and egg yolks.
Rationale: Emulsifiers (like lecithin) possess both hydrophilic and lipophilic ends, stabilizing immiscible oil-and-water emulsions in dressings and sauces.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): How many pints are there in 1 quart?
Rationale: Standard culinary volume conversions: 1 quart = 2 pints = 4 cups = 32 fluid ounces.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Weights & Measures, Kitchen Math

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The three categories of food contaminants are best described as:
Rationale: Standard HACCP and food safety classification groups all contaminants into Biological hazards (microorganisms), Chemical hazards (cleaning chemicals, toxins), and Physical hazards (glass, metal, bones).

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Substances in plant-based foods with physiologically active compounds that have functional benefits are called ___.
Rationale: Phytochemicals are naturally occurring biologically active chemical compounds found in plants (e.g., polyphenols, carotenoids, flavonoids) that provide health benefits and disease protection.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): The mother sauce of all white sauces is called ___.
Rationale: Bechamel is one of the classic French grand mother sauces made by thickening warm milk with a white roux (equal parts butter and flour). Espagnole is brown sauce.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): This is a paste that is used to make hummus.
Rationale: Tahini is a smooth, rich paste made from toasted ground sesame seeds, a mandatory base ingredient blended with chickpeas, lemon, and garlic to make authentic hummus.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Middle Eastern Cuisine, Culinary Arts

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Oxidative rancidity happens in foods that have ___.
Rationale: Oxidative rancidity occurs when oxygen attacks double bonds of unsaturated fatty acids (polyunsaturated fats), forming lipid hydroperoxides that break down into foul-smelling aldehydes and ketones.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): When one person or department purchases for every department, it is called ___.
Rationale: Centralized purchasing designates a single purchasing manager or procurement department to handle all purchasing across every department in the organization, maximizing volume discounts.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If you open sealed bids and place the order with the lowest bid, you are using which buying method?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Rationale: In standard research methodology: Step 1 is selecting/determining the research topic, followed immediately by Step 2: identifying the problem and stating specific goals and objectives.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Research Methodology, Foodservice Administration

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Rationale: Under the Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, a food is deemed 'adulterated' if it consists in whole or in part of any filthy, putrid, or decomposed substance, or if it was prepared under unsanitary conditions.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Laws, Food Safety

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): A bacon spread has a serving size of 30 g. What is the equivalent household measurement?
Rationale: In standard Philippine dietary food exchange lists and household measurements, 1 tablespoon of semi-solid spread or condiment is approximately 15 grams; hence 30 grams = 2 tablespoons.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Weights & Measures, Food Exchange List

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Rationale: Listeria monocytogenes is a psychrotrophic pathogen commonly transmitted via raw, unpasteurized milk and soft cheeses, causing listeriosis with fever, headaches, and bacteremia.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Question (Front): Which is the PRIMARY cause of food borne illness?
Rationale: Bacteria (such as Salmonella, Campylobacter, S. aureus, and E. coli) are the leading cause of bacterial foodborne intoxications and infections worldwide.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is NOT a required benefit of an employee?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): How do you call the poisonous toxins which can be found in peanut, tree nuts, corn and copra?
Rationale: Aflatoxins are potent hepatocarcinogenic mycotoxins produced by the molds Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus, frequently contaminating improperly dried peanuts, corn, and copra.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which is the commission that formulates internationally accepted food safety standards to protect the public and ensure fair trade practices?
Rationale: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC), established jointly by FAO and WHO, establishes international food codes, standards, and guidelines for consumer health protection and fair food trade.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): If a broiler is 7-12-week-old chicken, fryer is ___.
Rationale: In poultry market classification, broilers are young tender birds (under 12 weeks), fryers are slightly older (14–20 weeks), and roasters are typically 5–10 months old.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which additive would add sweetness, act as a stabilizer and thickener, and retain moistness in a muffin?
Rationale: Sorbitol is a polyol (sugar alcohol) that imparts sweetness, functions as a humectant to retain moisture, and increases batter viscosity without crystallizing.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Being non-flammable, asbestos is good for ___.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Which countries are known for pastries?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What organisms can cause spoilage to food inside the refrigerator?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Chicken curry is NOT a popular dish in ___.
Rationale: Curry is a foundational staple dish across South and Southeast Asia (India, Thailand, Indonesia). While Germany has currywurst (sausage with spiced ketchup), chicken curry is not traditional German cuisine.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Why are molds not the common microorganisms in heated canned products?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Large group of people experience acute gastroenteritis 4 to 6 hours after eating custard pie. Which bacteria are MOST likely the culprit?
Rationale: Staphylococcus aureus produces heat-stable enterotoxins in high-protein, creamy foods (like custards and cream pastries). It has a uniquely rapid incubation period of 1 to 6 hours causing sudden vomiting and diarrhea.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): Identify the people/populations that experience the most serious consequences of foodborne illnesses.
Rationale: Individuals with compromised immune systems (chemotherapy patients, organ transplant recipients, HIV/AIDS) have diminished cellular defense mechanisms and experience the highest rates of systemic bacteremia and mortality.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, Food Safety, Public Health

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Foods & Food Service Systems
Question (Front): What do you call the noodles in Thailand?
Rationale: Pad Thai is Thailand's national stir-fried rice noodle dish. Bibimbap, Bulgogi, and Japchae are iconic dishes of South Korea.
Tags: PRC-2021, FFSS, International Cuisines, Southeast Asia

Question (Front): A management function that involves developing mission statements, setting goals and outlining steps needed to meet those goals:

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Diet-related components that may be protective against CHD include all of the following, EXCEPT:
Rationale: Cardioprotective dietary components include antioxidant nutrients like Vitamin E (which inhibits LDL oxidation), soluble fiber (which binds bile acids and lowers serum total and LDL cholesterol), and B-vitamins such as folate, B6, and B12 (which lower circulating homocysteine, an independent vascular risk factor). Vitamin K functions primarily in hepatic synthesis of blood clotting factors (II, VII, IX, X) and bone mineralization (osteocalcin carboxylation), and is not classified as a CHD-protective nutrient.
Option 1: A. antioxidant nutrients, particularly vit. E
Tags: Cardiovascular Nutrition, Heart Disease, Vitamins, Lipids

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): The term that describes the volume of formula that remains in the stomach from a previous feeding is:

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front):
Using the PEL as basis, approximately how many grams of protein will this meal provide?
- 3/4 cup rice
- 3 exchanges of fried chicken breast
- 1 cup salad greens with vinegar as dressing
- 1 exchange banana
Rationale:
Calculation using the Philippine Food Exchange Lists (PEL):
1. Rice: 1 exchange = 1/2 cup cooked rice = 2 g protein. Thus, 3/4 cup cooked rice = 1.5 exchanges * 2 g = 3 g protein.
2. Chicken breast: 1 exchange of lean/medium meat = 8 g protein. 3 exchanges * 8 g = 24 g protein.
3. Salad greens: 1 cup raw leafy vegetables = 1 exchange Vegetable Group A/B = 1 g protein.
4. Banana: 1 exchange Fruit = 0 g protein.
Total Protein = 3 g (rice) + 24 g (chicken) + 1 g (greens) + 0 g (fruit) = 28 gm.
Tags: PEL, Food Exchange System, Calculations, Protein

Question (Front): Plain, cool water is the best fluid for everyday active people because it _____.

Option 2: B. rapidly leaves the digestive tract to enter the tissues and cool the body

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Diet management for Congestive Heart Failure include the following interventions. Which one is prohibited because it can provoke cardiac arrythmia?
Rationale: Excessive caffeine (a central nervous system and cardiac beta-adrenergic stimulant) and heavy alcohol intake can precipitate tachyarrhythmias, atrial fibrillation ('holiday heart syndrome'), and myocardial depression in patients with compromised cardiac function and heart failure.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Much of these nutrients is the LEAST affected during stress _____.
Rationale: During acute metabolic stress (sepsis, trauma, burns), hypermetabolism causes profound alterations in glucose turnover (hyperglycemia), amino acid mobilization (accelerated muscle proteolysis), and fluid/electrolyte balance. Fat-soluble Vitamin E has extensive adipose and hepatic stores and its turnover is least acutely altered during acute stress.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Fluid balance is an aspect of the homeostasis of organisms which the concentration of electrolytes are kept at a healthy level. The state of body fluid volume balance is _____.
Rationale: Euvolemia refers to the optimal, physiologically normal circulating blood and extracellular fluid volume in the human body, balancing fluid intake and excretory outputs.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Which of the following describes fat soluble vitamins?
Answer (Back): A. Can be stored in the liver and fatty tissues and can reach toxic levels.
Rationale: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, and K) are absorbed along with dietary lipids via mixed micelles and chylomicrons and are stored extensively in hepatic tissue and adipose reserves. Because they are not readily excreted in urine, excessive chronic intakes can accumulate to toxic levels (hypervitaminosis A or D).
Option 1: A. Can be stored in the liver and fatty tissues and can reach toxic levels.
Option 2: B. It includes Vit A and Vit. C
Option 3: C. Can't be stored to any great extent so must be consumed daily.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Patients with calcium oxalate stones may benefit from diet that restrict:
Rationale: In calcium oxalate nephrolithiasis, high sodium intake reduces renal tubular reabsorption of calcium, causing hypercalciuria, while excessive dietary oxalate increases urinary oxalate concentration. Restricting oxalate-rich foods (spinach, rhubarb, beets, chocolate, nuts) and maintaining low sodium (<2,000 mg/day) with normal dietary calcium intake (which binds oxalate in the gut) prevents stone recurrence.
Tags: Renal Nutrition, Nephrolithiasis, Oxalate, Sodium, MNT

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): The hormone that moves milk through the mammary gland?
Rationale: Oxytocin, secreted by the posterior pituitary, stimulates the contraction of myoepithelial cells surrounding the mammary alveoli to eject milk into the lactiferous ducts ('let-down reflex' or milk ejection). In contrast, prolactin stimulates milk production/synthesis.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): In celiac disease, a fraction of the protein gluten in wheat and corresponding protein fractions in barley, oats and rye:

Option 2: B. acts as toxic substance and called the intestinal villi to lose their absorptive capacity

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): What is the best nutritional assessment you as an ND utilize when diagnosing a food allergy?

Rationale: A comprehensive prospective 1-to-2 week food and symptom diary recording exact foods, ingredients, cooking methods, quantities, timing of ingestion, and precise onset and nature of symptoms is the gold standard dietary assessment tool used by dietitians before structuring targeted elimination diets.

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Which fat-soluble vitamin if lacking, can cause impaired vision in reduced light?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Heat syndrome results when the body's production of heat increases at a faster rate than the body's ability to dissipate heat loss. Which of the following is the type of heat syndrome in its most severe from?

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): When monitoring for food allergy, which outcome should be measured?
Answer (Back): D. reduction of food related reactions

Option 4: D. reduction of food related reactions

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Because its nitrogenous wastes contribute to uremia, the following nutrient may be restricted in diets of renal clients

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front): Giving cytotoxic chemotherapeutic agents produces all of the following nutrition impact symptoms, EXCEPT:

Tags: Oncology Nutrition, Chemotherapy, Nutrition Impact Symptoms, Clinical Dietetics

Deck Title: PRC NDLE 2021 - Nutritional Biochemistry & Clinical Dietetics
Question (Front):

I. Formation of the plasma protein
II. Regulates the blood pressure
III. Stimulates the red blood cell production
